text:
deploy-bot: launching config-only change: routing weight rebalance + tighter batching. Canary 7% for 20m. Change window 19:30-21:30 UTC. Patch summary: prefer eu-west by +12%, reduce batch_max_tokens to 16, per_router_concurrency=4, request_timeout_ms=1400. Health pings every 4m.

zoe: rationale - reduce p99 tail seen in EU. No model pins. Exclude test-tenant and tenant-gamma from canary.

amar: noted exclusions. Add infra guard: drain on OOM, mark node unhealthy for 8m.

ops-bot: exclusions updated [test-tenant, tenant-gamma]; oom_drain=true; unhealthy_ttl_min=8.

pat: rollback triggers: region p99 > 1050ms or error_rate +1.0% absolute or infra_ooms >=2 within 12m. If triggered, use `/deploybot revert-config` and run `/deploybot audit` after rollback.

zoe: ops snippet to paste into runbook:
```yaml
change: config-only
canary: 7pct for 20m -> step to 25pct on green
routing:
  prefer: eu-west-1
  weight_delta: +12
batching:
  max_tokens: 16
  per_router_concurrency: 4
timeouts_ms: 1400
exclude: [test-tenant, tenant-gamma]
autoscaler:
  oom_drain: true
  unhealthy_ttl_min: 8
rollback_triggers:
  region_p99_ms: 1050
  error_rate_abs_pct: 1.0
  infra_ooms_12m: 2
```

deploy-bot: canary started 2026-07-09T19:31:40Z. Dash links: /dash/route-rebalance, /dash/batch-samples. Alerting to @zoe and @pat.

(4m) amar: health check: eu p50 60ms p95 310ms p99 880ms, error_rate +0.1%, kv_cache_miss +0.3% — within guardrails.

(11m) pat: one node hit OOM and was drained; autoscaler replaced it. No client errors.

(21m) zoe: green to step to 25%. Publishing release note draft: "Config-only: routing weighted toward eu-west (+12), batch_max_tokens lowered to 16, per-router concurrency limited to 4, request timeout 1400ms. Canary 7% -> 25% on green. Excluded test-tenant and tenant-gamma. Rollback if region p99>1050ms, error rate +1.0% abs, or >=2 infra OOMs in 12m. Autoscaler oom drain enabled."

deploy-bot: commands: `/deploybot revert-config`, `/deploybot show-exclusions`. Next health post in 4m with top slow traces and flamegraph attachment.
